articles.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
articles.summary: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay upfront, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.
